Connection & setup ＋
  1. Install the v4 MeditationVest ESP32 firmware. Use v4 after replacing CH2’s old HX710 sensor: CH1 analog D34, CH2 analog D32. Until then, keep firmware v3. Disconnect the actuator battery and leave JP5 open during upload.
  2. Keep both boards on their current CH1 and CH2 ports; CH2’s new sensor reuses its existing D32 wire. The old D33 clock is unused. Open this HTTPS page in Bluefy.
  3. Tap Connect hub, then choose MeditationVest. Use Run once, or expand Repeat pattern.
  4. To synchronize two boards, choose them and tap Link boards. The shared controls set both boards’ times. Unlink restores their individual settings.

Each cycle: valve selects for 0.1 s → pump → hold → release. There is no fixed wait after a single run or the final cycle. Repeat patterns use your chosen released interval between cycles; 0 s adds no deliberate pause, so the bag may not fully deflate.

Set count runs 1–999 total cycles and finishes even after a Bluetooth disconnect. Until Stop repeats until you stop it; if Bluetooth disconnects, it finishes the current cycle and releases. Reconnection never starts a pattern. Stop & release stops all channels immediately when received by the hub.

CH1 and CH2 on v4 show sensor output voltage directly, with a 30-second chart and ADC limit indicator. They need no display zero. The exact sensor variant and pressure calibration are still unconfirmed. Supply it from 3.3 V; never feed a 5 V output into D34 or D32.

On older v2/v3 firmware with the HX710 still fitted on CH2, set vented zero only when the bag is fully deflated. 0–100% shows the positive digital range above that zero; it is not a pressure calibration. Raw counts remain available below the chart. Sensor readings do not stop the pumps.

CH1 + CH2 can now run together. Simultaneous pump current has not been measured; the battery output and shared-wire ratings remain unknown. Check the first linked trial on the bench.
